newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's real dips 0.03 pct in calm trading.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's real dips 0.03 pct in calm trading.

text.p: Brazil's real dipped 0.03 percent to close at 1.0649 per dollar in calm trading on the commercial foreign exchange market, dealers said.
Some players expect a new decline in the reais-dollar mini-band later this week while others do not expect a change before next week, they said.
The current mini-band was set on Tuesday by the Central Bank at between 1.0645 and 1.0695 reais per dollar, down 0.09 percent from the previous one.
In the interbank floating rate market, the real closed at 1.0695 per dollar, up 0.01 percent.
In the parallel market, the real fell 0.44 percent to end at 1.140 per dollar, traders said.
